title: AI is changing the cyber threat landscape, Dutch SURF post says
content_md:
Artificial intelligence is changing the cyber threat landscape. Not because new forms of cybercrime have emerged. The post text cuts off at that point and links to a SURF article asking whether institutions are prepared:

https://sec.surf.nl/ai-versnelt-cyberaanvallen-is-jouw-instelling-voorbereid
